page.notes: The first word "stitiæ" is a fragment at the head of the page, the start of the previous line cut off; it is kept as a fragment. "Resipuissent" is read with some doubt from the scan. "tato" in "tato Dei" is uncertain and marked. The page number 165 is printed at the top right; the running head is taken from the printed header "ABSOLUTI CONSOCIATIO". The right-hand reference "lib. 1." on the foot line is treated as a marginal note at the end of the text. Marginal notes sit in the right margin and are placed beside their lines.
